title: Decide
description: Two days in a room with everyone who can say yes. We leave with a scope that fits on one page and a list of what we are deliberately not building.

title: Make
description: Design and engineering run in the same week, not in sequence. You see working software every Friday, on a real URL, from week two onward.

title: Ship
description: We launch it, watch the first hundred people use it, fix what breaks, and hand over a repository your team can keep building in.
